name: io.github.tonyyang0504/shopee_open_platform-mcp
description: Shopee Seller Centre + Shopee Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, g

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_PARTNER_ID
environmentVariables.description: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App list).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_PARTNER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The app's partner_key; signs the refresh request and every call (lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256) and is never sent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: shop_id that authorised the app (returned in the authorisation redirect).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The shop's refresh_token from v2.public.get_access_token (valid 30 days, single-use). Each refresh (every ~4 h) returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_HOST
environmentVariables.description: API host: partner.shopeemobile.com (global production), openplatform.shopee.cn (mainland China), openplatform.shopee.com.br (Brazil) or openplatform.sandbox.test-stable.shopee.sg (sandbox).
